saw_lines: Sneaker buyers pick a model they already know, then come back for the next colourway the week it drops.
So the sale is won in the first line where a shopper decides if this drop is for them.
Your 20 ads with written copy carry no proof number, so buyers have nothing to trust. Collect a real figure like orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 20 ads with written copy carry a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust before the click. Collect a real figure like orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.

2 of 20 ads are creator posts, and they run from your brand page, so the trust a creator builds reads as a brand pitch. Whitelist them from the creator accounts, then cut three variations with new opening lines.
6 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage instead of the product the ad shows, so a buyer who clicks has to search again. Point each of those six ads to the product page for the model it shows.
0 of 20 ads carry an offer, so a first-time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer or a bundle into three new ads, and name the saving in the first line.

ads_1: Model-led creative with a first order offer and a proof figure up front
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
